name: OpenSkillEval
intro: OpenSkillEval 是一个自动审计开放技能生态的 Agent 评测框架。它固定任务并切换社区贡献的 skill pack，覆盖数据可视化、海报生成、PPT 生成、报告生成和网页设计五类真实工作流，用统一 runner、Docker 沙箱和家族级 evaluator 同时衡量输出质量、技能增益和 token/时间成本。
build_method: 动态任务构建, 社区技能收集, 统一Agent runner
modality: 文本, 图像, 文档, 代码
task_type: Agent任务, 技能评估, 真实工作流
eval_feature: 技能生态审计, 动态任务, 成本质量分析
task_type_en: Agent task, Skill evaluation, Real-world workflow
build_method_en: Dynamic task construction, community skill collection, unified agent runner
eval_feature_en: Skill ecosystem audit, dynamic tasks, cost-quality analysis
intro_en: OpenSkillEval is an automatic benchmark for auditing the open skill ecosystem for LLM agents. It holds tasks fixed while varying community-contributed skill packs across data visualization, poster generation, slide generation, report generation, and web design workflows, using a unified runner, Docker sandboxes, and family-specific evaluators to measure output quality, skill gains, and token/time cost.
